evidence.source: persisted GSC query×page rows (public.seo_gsc_rows), read-only; no live GSC API pull was made
evidence.cohortRule: smallest descending URL cohort whose cumulative off-mission impressions reach at least 75% of all off-mission impressions, including every URL tied at the boundary
evidence.perUrlOffMissionSplitReason: The 2026-09-20 P5 audit measured off-mission cohort totals (613 impressions / 134 rows / 37 URLs / 0 clicks) and the 75% leading cohort, but did not publish a per-URL off-mission split. Per-URL values must be re-derived from persisted rows with classifyGscVisibility() before a number is recorded here — they are left null (UNKNOWN) rather than fabricated as 0.
knownLimitations: Persisted-window evidence only: it proves the classification of the persisted 2026-06-22 → 2026-09-19 rows, not live Google index state.
Off-mission rows stay observable in raw GSC reporting/measurement surfaces; this contract only governs action surfaces.
Per-URL impressions/rows/clicks and live status/sitemap/robots/ownership observations are UNKNOWN (null) for all eight entries.
